hook: A Karkhana house turns into a *51-seat* arts space
hook_b: A Karkhana house turns into a *51-seat* arts space
tldr: Platform 51, a new arts space in Vikrampuri Colony, Karkhana, is hosting trial events ahead of an official launch.

beats.what: A 700 sq ft stage with a green room; a café, amphitheatre and banquet hall are planned, per The Hindu.
beats.why: Co-founder Prerna Kirthi says she chose Secunderabad over West Hyderabad, seen as the city's growth centre, to return to her roots.
beats.care: Plays and a Sufi night are planned for Secunderabad, closer to home for people in the twin city.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: It is not officially open yet; trial events are running to iron out operational issues, per The Hindu.

cards.q: A new arts space in Secunderabad: what would bring you in?

qs: What kinds of arts spaces exist in Secunderabad compared with West Hyderabad?
Will small venues like this stay affordable for performers?

facts.t: The venue sits in a *four-decade-old house* in a quiet residential neighbourhood that keeps its architectural character.

steps.e: Investors pulled out; RK Shenoy stepped in

viz.verdict: A new arts venue for Secunderabad residents, not yet officially open

viz.l: performance space with stage and green room

watch: The official launch date; plays and a Sufi night are planned, per the founders.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Inside Secunderabad's new community hub for art and theatre

fact: A four-decade-old Karkhana house is now Platform 51, seating just *51 people*.
twist: Its *50-cm-thick* brick walls diffuse sound, so performers don't need mics, co-founder RK Shenoy told The Hindu.
